name: led-5mm
title: 5 mm LED, red
description: Round 5 mm through-hole LED, red and diffused, two leads on 2.54 mm. The longer lead is the anode. It warns above 30 mA and 75 mW. The page's glow is the mean current since the last frame, so a PWM-dimmed LED glows at its average.

notSimulated.why: The engine reports current, not luminous intensity. The drawing scales current by 10 mA, so the glow is 1 at 10 mA and blooms above that. The candela at that current is not modeled. The forward curve is fitted from 2 mA to 20 mA as its source names. Below 2 mA and above 20 mA the current is that curve extended. A threshold at 1 mA would sit outside the fit. Luminous intensity versus forward current is drawn as a straight line from 0 mA, so the extended current still glows in proportion.
The fits are at 25 C and the engine has no temperature.
The engine's LED has no breakdown voltage.
